#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One construct per release above the bash 3.2 floor.
mapfile -t FILES < <(ls)            # 4.0
declare -A table                    # 4.0
lower=${RAW,,}                      # 4.0
declare -g everywhere=1             # 4.2
declare -n alias=FILES              # 4.3
quoted=${RAW@Q}                     # 4.4
now=$EPOCHSECONDS                   # 5.0
echo "$FILES $table $lower $everywhere $alias $quoted $now"
